[[Quelev Tapper]] maintained a '''headquarters''' inside [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] territory in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. It was [[Destruction of Quelev Tapper's headquarters|destroyed]] by Imperial forces, forcing Tapper to merge the remnants of his [[Quelev Tapper's organization|organization]] with [[Talon Karrde]]'s.
